label: DOESCL/badmat_3d
comment: DOESCL YOUNG of missing material 9: "Scale 2.000000 YOUNG  : Mat# 9" then "Error on reading DOESCL : material # 9 is not defined."

label: DOESCL/badobj_3d
comment: DOESCL NDTMP of missing object 9: "Scale 2.000000 NDTMP  : Obj# 9" then "Error on reading DOESCL : object # 9 is not defined."

label: DOESCL/blankfactor_3d
comment: DOESCL with nothing after the keyword: factor reader returns 1 -> Reading Error; the next line "NDTMP 2" is then read by the KEY loop as an NDTMP keyword (object 2, rest of line empty -> its own error)

label: DOESCL/fperv_3d
comment: DOESCL FPERV with flags 1 0: first set FPERV constants 2.0 and 3.0, then only the first (Body Force, +0x1ef0) is scaled: 20.0, second stays 3.0

label: DOESCL/fperv_both_3d
comment: DOESCL FPERV with flags 0 1: only the second quantity (+0x1f68) scaled: 2.0 stays, 3.0 -> 30.0

label: DOESCL/fstres_nontab_3d
comment: DOESCL FSTRES on a non-tabular flow stress (seed FSTRES 1 1, mode != 1): message printed, nothing scaled

label: DOESCL/fstres_tab_2d
comment: DOESCL FSTRES on a tabular flow stress (seed FSTRES 1 2, mode +0x50 = 1): every flow-stress table value x 1.1; prints "Scale 1.100000 FSTRES : Mat# 1" and the VarFieldWidth debug line

label: DOESCL/loctmp_2d
comment: DOESCL LOCTMP object 3 window 2, flags 1 1 0 0 0: Env temperature 25 -> 50 and Conv. coef 0.3 -> 0.6, others unchanged; window 1 untouched

label: DOESCL/loctmp_win0_2d
comment: DOESCL LOCTMP window number 0: positional lookup gives the first window; all five flags set (Htc skipped, byte +0x560 = 0)

label: DOESCL/movctl_ham_t0_2d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL type 0 on a hammer (object 2, energy 2.712E7): energy x 0.5 = 1.356E7

label: DOESCL/movctl_ham_t1_2d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL type 1 on a hammer: energy assigned = 1.0E7

label: DOESCL/movctl_ham_t2_2d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL type 2 on a hammer without efficiency table: efficiency 0.6 assigned 0.8

label: DOESCL/movctl_ham_t3_2d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL type field 3 on a hammer: no message, nothing changed

label: DOESCL/movctl_screw_t0_2d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL type 0 on a screw press (object 2, energy 4.52E7): energy x 2.0 = 9.04E7

label: DOESCL/movctl_screw_t2_2d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL type 2 on a screw press: efficiency 0.9 assigned 0.75 (when the screw table T@+0x2400 is constant)

label: DOESCL/movctl_speed_3d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL on movement type 1 (speed): the speed table/constant (1.0) x 3.0 = 3.0 whatever the type field; message "Scale energy 3.000000 MOVCTL : Obj# 1 type 0"

label: DOESCL/movctl_speed_t2_3d
comment: DOESCL MOVCTL type field 2 on a speed object: still scales the speed (1.0 x 3.0), message "Assign efficiency ..."

label: DOESCL/ndtmp_2d
comment: DOESCL NDTMP on the 2D seed: object 1 node temperatures x 2.0 (2D KEY writer prints T-dT and T pairs, see NDTMP.md)

label: DOESCL/ndtmp_3d
comment: DOESCL NDTMP: node temperatures of object 2 (1200) x 0.5 = 600; objects 1 and 3 unchanged

label: DOESCL/unknown_kw_3d
comment: DOESCL with an unknown name (id 305): "undefined keyword definition", status 0

label: DOESCL/unsupported_kw_3d
comment: DOESCL with a real but unsupported keyword (STRAIN): "Error on reading DOESCL : undefined keyword definition", nothing changed, status 0

label: DOESCL/young_2d
comment: DOESCL YOUNG: constant Young modulus 2.06843E5 x 0.5 = 1.034215E5 (one MULSD)
